arcana.name: Arcana
arcana.desc: Domain of innate and instinctual magic.

bone.name: Bone
bone.desc: Domain of tactics and the body.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.desc: Out of sight from all enemies. Rolls against you have disadvantage. Cleared when enemies see you, you enter their line of sight, or you attack.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.desc: Can't move, but can still take actions from your current position.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.desc: All rolls targeting you have advantage.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.desc: Roll a d6 before each action roll. On 4 or lower, mark a Stress.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.desc: An opponent can mark a Stress when you roll with Hope to turn it into a roll with Fear instead.

ignited.name: Ignited
ignited.desc: Take 1d4 magic damage when you make an action roll.

exiled.name: Exiled
exiled.desc: You and your allies have disadvantage during social situations within the Noble's domain.

enveloped.name: Enveloped
enveloped.desc: Mark an additional Stress every action roll. Cleared when the Ooze takes Severe damage.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.desc: Can't use Regeneration but immune to magic damage.

trapped.name: Trapped
trapped.desc: Restrained and Vulnerable. Break free with a successful Instinct Roll.

guilty.name: Guilty
guilty.desc: Standard attacks against you deal Severe damage instead.
